exploreItems.title: Required payment
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Tribute was demanded under colonial authority, rather than simply offered as a gift.

exploreItems.title: Colonial resources
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Collections supplied resources to the colonial system.

exploreItems.title: Agreement is separate
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Recorded payment does not prove that a person approved of the demand.

exploreItems.title: Named dates
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The NHCP marker dates formal establishment to March 1782 and abolition to 1882.

exploreItems.title: Control
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Designated districts faced compulsory cultivation and government purchase at an official price.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A monopoly period is not the whole history of a crop or every farms experience.

exploreItems.title: Ports
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Manila and Acapulco were linked across the Pacific.

exploreItems.title: Period
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: 1565-1815 identifies this trade connection, not all Philippine exchange.

exploreItems.title: Diagram limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A schematic link is not the exact sailing track of every voyage.

exploreItems.title: Demand
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: An order identifies what was required.

exploreItems.title: Delivery
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A receipt can record goods handed over.

exploreItems.title: Payment
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A promise of future payment does not prove payment was received.

exploreItems.title: More than coins
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Early accounts describe goods, including cloth and rice, in some tribute collections.

exploreItems.title: Work behind goods
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Products represent work and materials, not objects that appeared without effort.

exploreItems.title: Local detail
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A named item does not establish one amount or form for every community.

exploreItems.title: Rule
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A policy can shape production and exchange.

exploreItems.title: Choice
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A required buyer can limit where a grower sells.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Check the product, place and period covered by the rule.

exploreItems.title: Direction
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Asian goods went toward the Americas while silver moved toward Manila.

exploreItems.title: Origin
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A loading port is not necessarily the place an object was made.

exploreItems.title: Cargo limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Examples do not establish every ships complete cargo or successful delivery.

exploreItems.title: Before and after
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The study distinguishes the end of tribute in 1884 from the later cedula system in 1885.

exploreItems.title: A changed system
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Ending one form of taxation did not mean that all taxes ended.

exploreItems.title: Check the record
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A dated payment needs the rule that applied in its own setting.

exploreItems.title: A named case
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The NHCP marker connects Sumuroy and Palapag with protest against forced labor and abuses in 1649.

exploreItems.title: Distance
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: CulturEd describes a demand for workers to go to Cavite for shipbuilding.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A named uprising does not establish every workers response or private motive.

exploreItems.title: Two viewpoints
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Government revenue and a growers household outcome are different questions.

exploreItems.title: Subtract listed costs
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Eight received minus five listed costs leaves three in the fictional model.

exploreItems.title: Missing information
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Check whether an account leaves out costs, work or payment delays.

exploreItems.title: Identify the demand
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Tribute, labor service and produce delivery should not be confused.

exploreItems.title: Compare resources
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The same demand can leave households with different resources.

exploreItems.title: Model boundary
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Twelve minus three is nine; seven minus three is four, in a fictional model only.

exploreItems.title: The product
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Bandala required agricultural produce for the colonial government.

exploreItems.title: Choice matters
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A compulsory sale is not the same as a freely chosen market sale.

exploreItems.title: Compare demands
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Polo concerned labor; bandala concerned produce delivery.

fields.title: Community Economy Evidence Challenge
fields.description: Complete 10 activities: five clue-and-conclusion decisions and five matching tasks. Both parts of an evidence decision count together as one activity. Get at least 7 activities correct. All supplied lesson clues are available without saving them in your journal.
